fields.System.Title: TRF-501 — On-hand plus in-transit across warehouses
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want one view of what every site holds and what is moving between
them, so that I can decide what to rebalance without querying each warehouse separately.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product, then the view shows on-hand, available, and inbound-in-transit per
  • warehouse — three separately named quantities, never one merged "stock" figure.
  • - Given in-transit stock, then it is attributed to the destination as inbound and is
  • not counted as available anywhere.
  • - Given the view, then each row carries last_updated_at and the API exposes it.
  • - Given the projection, then a rebuild job exists and is delivered with this story.
  • - Given a nightly reconciliation, then the projection is compared against source
  • balances and any mismatch alerts.
  • - Given the view, then it is never used to make an allocation decision.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | network stock projection, stock_balance |
| Risks | In-transit counted as available at both sites ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); projection drift ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · rebuild-vs-incremental agreement · invariant |
